bindings.caption: Heat Cd oxide, Zn oxide, and oleic acid in a three-neck flask under N2. temperature: 150 ℃. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.
